args.title: Clarify upload size limits in documentation
args.body:
File: none

The issue asks about the largest file size that can be uploaded, but there is no explicit documentation or code enforcing a limit. The request is for guidance on whether the limit can be raised for their account. Since this is a question about documentation or account-specific limits, no code change is needed, but the documentation should be updated to address upload size constraints or clarify how to request adjustments.
